title: Child Prodigy
content: Kieron Williamson is a  seven-year-old in the UK who is becoming known for his paintings. In this link, he’s the subject of aReuters news feature.This kid makes me feel like a late bloomer. I didn’t do a lot of drawing until I was around 13, It wasn’t until about then I was starting to think about being an artist. I didn’t really get into oil painting and professional work until I was about 20. The blessing of those teenage years was that art was a private passion, something completely disconnected from commerce and recognition. I find that in my professional life I feed on those teenage years of drawing just for the love of it.But I think young Kieron will do well. Both he and his dad seem to have their feet on the ground.Photo and article atLost at E MinorThanks,Dan, Mr. Kindergarten!
